findings.location: Paragraph beginning “Has the true church slipped so far…”; Ephesians 5:11 quotation
findings.source_quote: And have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather reprove them.
findings.suggested_fix: 将“那暗昧无益的事，不要与人同行，倒要责备行这事的人”改为“不要与黑暗无益的行为有份，倒要责备这些行为”。
findings.translation_quote: 那暗昧无益的事，不要与人同行，倒要责备行这事的人
